llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent with its description: it runs local Python scripts to manage a personal knowledge DB, requires no external credentials, and performs only local file/SQLite operations.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (personal knowledge engine: add/search/link/distill/visualize concepts) matches the included artifacts: concept_manager.py, concept_synthesis.py, ke_api.py, visualize.py, and schema docs. No unexpected third‑party services or credentials are required. The presence of a ke_api for sub‑agent use aligns with the '子 Agent API' feature in the README/SKILL.md.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs only to run provided local Python scripts (search/add/link/synthesis/visualize/eval). The runtime instructions and scripts operate on a local SQLite DB and JSON files under a 'memory/' directory and output a local HTML visualization (~/Desktop/knowledge-graph.html). The instructions do not ask the agent to read unrelated system files or to call external endpoints. The docs explicitly state 'no network requests' and 'zero external dependencies', which matches the scripts (standard library only).
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec — this is instruction-only from the platform perspective. The README suggests cloning a GitHub repo or using an external 'clawhub' installer, but the skill bundle itself contains all scripts and uses only the Python standard library. No remote downloads or archive extraction are performed by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required env vars or credentials. The code does read an optional environment variable KNOWLEDGE_DB to override the DB path; this is reasonable as a convenience but is not documented in SKILL.md. Because that env var can point the skill at an arbitrary DB path, users should avoid setting it to sensitive system paths. Otherwise, requested access (writing to memory/ and creating the SQLite DB and JSON files) is proportional to a local knowledge manager.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false (not forced into every run). The skill can be invoked autonomously (disable-model-invocation:false) which is the platform default; combined with the scripts' auto-distillation and auto-adjust features the skill can autonomously create/modify many concept and insight records in the local memory/ store. It does not modify other skills or system-wide agent settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and local-first: it stores and manipulates data in a local memory/ folder and SQLite DB, needs no external credentials, and uses only Python standard libs. Before installing: (1) review and back up the workspace/memory/ directory (the skill will create and modify JSON files and a SQLite DB); (2) do not set KNOWLEDGE_DB to point at any sensitive system database—if you need to change DB location, point it to a dedicated directory; (3) if you want to limit side effects, disable autonomous invocation for this skill (so it runs only when you explicitly call it), since it can auto-distill and auto-adjust confidence; (4) run the code in an isolated environment (or on a copy of your data) the first time to confirm behavior; (5) note future planned features (chromadb, sentence-transformers, networked sharing) will require additional installs and will change the threat model—re-evaluate then.
